messages:
deploy-bot: Deployed release v2026.03.21-ff9 to prod (canary->100%). Post-deploy smoke set: rerank-probe (1000 queries), embeddings-health, api-liveness.
Aisha: rerank-probe aggregate looks odd for eu-west-1 0m after deploy. Top-1 accuracy vs baseline dropped from 0.78 -> 0.62. No 5xx.
Aisha: probe summary:
```
region=eu-west-1
queries=1000
top1_baseline=0.78
top1_current=0.62
avg_rank_delta=+1.9
errors=0
note: model variant changed from rerank-v2 -> rerank-v3-runtime
```
Ravi: rerank-v3 runtime included a scoring normalization change per PR#4821. Did we enable the new norm in prod by mistake?
Lena: confirm the rollout config had feature-flag rerank_norm=true for v3. That should have been gated. Looks like flag defaulted to true on the new config bundle. Opening INF-5201.
PerfBot: synthetic scoring distribution attached: heavy left-shift on normalization weights for long query pairs.
Aisha: customer-facing products may see degraded top result. Recommend immediate partial pin for eu-west-1 back to rerank-v2 while we fix flag.
Ravi: agree. @deploy-bot run routing-bump region=eu-west-1 target=rerank-v2 scope=rerank-routing reason="postdeploy-quality-regression"
deploy-bot: executing routing-bump...
deploy-bot: routing bump applied for eu-west-1 -> rerank-v2 (ts=1800000030). Affected clusters: rerank-eu-1, rerank-eu-2.
oncall-bot: post-bump rerank-probe: top1_current returned to 0.77 within 45s. avg_rank_delta -0.1.
Lena: INF-5201 created: mis-set feature flag in config bundle -> rollback candidate. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5201
Ravi: follow-ups: (1) config bundle rollback + add unit test to ensure feature-flag default=false; (2) add a canary gate for rerank-normalization to smoke suite; (3) coordinate release note update mentioning scoring normalization opt-in.
Aisha: tagging product ops and support with short blurb for customers in eu-west-1. Keeping release marked as "region-pinned: eu-west-1" until fix shipped.
deploy-bot: summary: routing bump applied to revert rerank variant in eu-west-1; synthetic rerank probe recovered. Tickets: INF-5201. Thread will remain open for the final fix verification."
